'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Nathan LS Yavin 4: Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nathan]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Throne Room]]
* '''Username:''' SolaGratia
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
